project.name: ree-v3
project.description: Active V3 implementation substrate for the REE cognitive-architecture research program, written in Python on PyTorch and NumPy. This scan is scoped to the two executable-code planes: ree_core/ (brain-region-named cognitive modules such as amygdala, PFC, hippocampal, sleep, cingulate, PAG, neuromodulation, basal-ganglia action-learning, affect and residue) and coordinator/ (a stdlib http.server coordination service with SQLite storage, a sync daemon and Phase-3 git writers). Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

nodes.summary: EMA-prototype conditioned safety predictor for SD-051 / MECH-304: learns which z_world states predict suffering absence via MECH-302 relief events (encoding pathway) and emits a sigmoid(cosine)-based safety_prediction scalar (expression pathway). Optional SD-066 centered mode subtracts a slow common-mode baseline before matching so a small cue residual can dominate under SD-008 z_world under-differentiation. nodes.name: _query

nodes.name: stack.py
nodes.summary: SD-005 split latent-space (L-space) implementation: z_self vs z_world encoders, harm-stream encoders (SD-010/SD-011), reafference predictor (SD-007), harm forward models (ARC-033/ARC-058), adversarial split head, and the LatentStack module gluing them into the shared z_beta/z_theta/z_delta context.
nodes.languageNotes: PyTorch nn.Module implementations with an autograd-Function gradient-reversal layer; 15 exported classes are the atomic pieces of the SD-005 encoder split.

nodes.name: ReafferencePredictor
nodes.summary: SD-007/MECH-098/MECH-101 perspective-shift corrector: predicts the z_world delta from self-motion (given z_world_raw_prev + a_prev) and subtracts it to yield perspective-corrected z_world (MSTd congruent/incongruent analog).

nodes.name: HarmEncoder
nodes.summary: SD-010 sensory-discriminative nociceptive encoder (A-delta analog): maps raw harm_obs -> z_harm_s used by E3.harm_eval_z_harm_head and E2HarmSForward.

nodes.name: AffectiveHarmEncoder
nodes.summary: SD-011 affective-motivational harm encoder (C-fiber analog): consumes harm_obs_a EMA + optional harm_history and produces z_harm_a plus an auxiliary harm_accum_pred head (SD-011 second-source + SD-020 surprise-PE target).

nodes.name: ResourceEncoder
nodes.summary: SD-015/SD-049-Phase-2 z_resource encoder plus the SD-049 identity-classifier head (Option-C hybrid): produces z_resource + resource_prox_pred_r + optional identity_logits for the goal-pipeline seeding path.

nodes.name: HarmForwardModel
nodes.summary: Simple MLP forward model f(z_harm, a) -> z_harm_pred_next used as the naive baseline against which the residual and shared-trunk harm forward models are compared.

nodes.name: HarmForwardTrunk
nodes.summary: ARC-058 shared PE trunk (unsigned, modality-independent): produces the shared hidden representation consumed by per-stream HarmForwardHead readouts (anterior insula PE hub analog).

nodes.name: HarmForwardHead
nodes.summary: ARC-058 stream-specific (signed) harm-forward head consumed by E2HarmSForward or E2HarmAForward when the shared-trunk configuration is selected.

nodes.name: ResidualHarmForward
nodes.summary: Residual delta-architecture forward model used by ARC-033 E2HarmSForward and SD-031 E2WorldForward: predicts a small delta on top of the identity, avoiding autocorrelated identity collapse.

nodes.name: HarmBridge
nodes.summary: Deprecated z_world -> z_harm bridge preserved for historical / ablation purposes; superseded by SD-010's direct HarmEncoder because bridge_r2 was architecturally zero.

nodes.name: _GradReverseFn
nodes.summary: torch.autograd.Function implementing the gradient-reversal layer used by AdversarialSplitHead (identity forward, negated gradient backward).

nodes.name: AdversarialSplitHead
nodes.summary: Adversarial head enforcing z_self/z_world separability via gradient reversal: penalises cross-stream information leakage during joint encoder training.

nodes.name: LatentState
nodes.summary: Immutable-ish dataclass holding the SD-005 split latent tuple (z_self, z_world) plus shared channels (z_beta/z_theta/z_delta), auxiliary predictions (resource proximity, harm accumulator), and post-SD-013 optional harm channels (z_harm, z_harm_a, z_harm_un, z_block, z_harm_suffering).

nodes.name: SplitEncoder
nodes.summary: SD-005 bottom-of-stack encoder: routes body/world observation channels through independent MLPs for z_self and z_world, with SD-018 resource-proximity head, top-down z_beta/z_delta conditioning, and shared trunk options.

nodes.name: SharedDepthEncoder
nodes.summary: Shared-depth encoder variant for ablations that couple the z_self/z_world encoders beyond the SD-005 split, retained as a controlled experimental knob.

nodes.name: LatentStack
nodes.summary: Top-level nn.Module orchestrator of the SD-005 L-space: builds encoders (SplitEncoder or SharedDepthEncoder), harm encoders (SD-010/SD-011), ReafferencePredictor (SD-007), ResourceEncoder (SD-015/SD-049), the DR-13 SelfRecurrenceCell, MECH-267 mode-noise/horizon scale, GABA harm-state recurrence (SD-036), and exposes encode/predict/compute_prediction_error/modulate_precision APIs.

nodes.name: ofc_analog.py
nodes.summary: Orbitofrontal-cortex analog module (SD-033b) providing state-code EMA and score-bias heads that inject candidate ranking bias into E3 trajectory selection, with a separate devaluation bias head decoupled from the primary discrimination head.
nodes.languageNotes: PyTorch nn.Module with register_buffer state and zeroed last-Linear inits for bit-identical OFF defaults.

nodes.name: OFCConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass configuration for OFCAnalog controlling state dim, update rate, outcome pool weight, bias scale, and gates for the state-bias head, devaluation head, and oracle usage.

nodes.name: OFCAnalog
nodes.summary: PFC-subdivision OFC analog nn.Module: maintains a per-tick EMA state code over z_world and optional z_harm, then emits per-candidate score biases via a state-bias head and an optional decoupled devaluation-bias head consumed by E3 selection.

nodes.name: __init__
nodes.summary: Constructs projection layers, state and devaluation bias-head MLPs, zeroes their last-Linear weights when not training, and registers the persistent state_code buffer for cross-tick EMA.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: MECH-261-gated EMA update of the OFC state code from projected z_world (and optional pooled z_harm) with the effective learning rate scaled by the SalienceCoordinator write gate.

nodes.name: compute_bias
nodes.summary: Concatenates the persistent state code with per-candidate z_world summaries and returns a clamped per-candidate scalar bias for E3 score composition, caching the mean-abs magnitude for diagnostics.

nodes.name: compute_devaluation_bias
nodes.summary: Emits a per-candidate bias from the decoupled devaluation head clamped to devaluation_bias_scale so that outcome revaluation can shift ranking beyond the primary bias-head clamp band.

nodes.name: query_outcome
nodes.summary: MECH-263 outcome-oracle path that runs the caller-supplied E2 harm-forward model under no_grad on detached inputs and caches the last prediction for diagnostics.

nodes.name: get_state
nodes.summary: Returns a diagnostics dict exposing state-code norm, last bias magnitudes, and oracle readiness/prediction stats used by experiment manifests and downstream governance readouts.

nodes.name: dacc.py
nodes.summary: Implements the SD-032b dACC/aMCC-analog adaptive control module -- computes precision-weighted affective prediction error (MECH-258), Shenhav-EVC per-candidate expected value, Croxson-style reward/effort interaction, Kolling foraging signal, and MECH-260 recency-suppression, then converts the integration bundle into an E3 score bias via a stopgap adapter pending the SD-032a salience-network coordinator.
nodes.languageNotes: Non-trainable nn.Module used as a control-plane arithmetic regulator; float scalars mixed with torch tensors; heavy inline docstrings encode MECH claim provenance and SD-034 closure-operator hooks.

nodes.name: DACCConfig
nodes.summary: Frozen-form dataclass carrying all sub-weights, precision/effort constants, MECH-268 saturation knobs, SD-034 pe_cap hook, and SD-057 L7 goal-readout controls for the dACC adaptive-control cluster; every knob defaults to zero/false so the module is no-op unless explicitly activated via REEConfig.use_dacc.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl
nodes.summary: Stateful non-trainable dACC/aMCC-analog module that integrates precision-weighted affective PE (MECH-258), Shenhav EVC per-candidate expected value, Croxson reward-x-effort interaction, Kolling foraging value, MECH-260 recency suppression, MECH-268 outcome-history saturation, and Scholl 2017 drive-gated coupling into a per-tick control-plane bundle.

nodes.name: DACCtoE3Adapter
nodes.summary: Stopgap adapter converting a DACCAdaptiveControl integration bundle into an additive per-candidate E3 score bias with an absolute clamp and an independent SD-057 L7 (MECH-348) object-discriminative goal-readout term; to be removed once SD-032a salience-network coordinator lands.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl.__init__
nodes.summary: Initialises the dACC module's per-episode state: PE EMA slot, action-history ring for MECH-260, outcome-history FIFO for MECH-268 saturation, and per-tick diagnostic slots used by experiment scripts.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl._affective_pe
nodes.summary: MECH-258 precision-weighted affective prediction error pipeline: forms ||z_harm_a - z_harm_a_pred||, applies precision-normalised gain, clamps to SD-034 dacc_pe_cap, then attenuates by the MECH-268 history-conditioned saturation factor for the current outcome class.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl._saturation_factor
nodes.summary: MECH-268 f_sat computation: counts recurrences of the current outcome class within the recent outcome-history window and returns a habituation multiplier plus the recurrence count, returning 1.0 when saturation is disabled or the class cannot be determined.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl.record_outcome
nodes.summary: Pushes an outcome class onto the MECH-268 saturation FIFO with a bounded double-window buffer; ClosureOperator clears this on rule-completion firing.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl._suppression_penalty
nodes.summary: MECH-260 per-candidate recency penalty: fraction of the recent action-history ring occupied by the queried action class, used to suppress monostrategy re-selection.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl.inject_nogo
nodes.summary: SD-034 targeted No-Go: injects a completed action class into the MECH-260 recency ring multiple times to bias the striatum away from re-selection, clipped by history memory.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl.forward
nodes.summary: Core per-tick dACC integration: computes precision-weighted PE, Shenhav EVC mode_ev, Croxson reward-x-effort interaction, choice difficulty, MECH-260 per-candidate suppression penalties, Kolling foraging value, SD-049 per-axis drive-gated coupling, and packages the full control-plane bundle including SD-057 L7 goal-readout and MECH-268 saturation diagnostics.

nodes.name: DACCtoE3Adapter.forward
nodes.summary: Converts a DACCAdaptiveControl bundle into a per-candidate E3 score bias by combining -mode_ev, Croxson interaction, Kolling foraging, and MECH-260 suppression terms with drive-gated dacc_weight and an absolute clamp, then adds an independently-weighted SD-057 L7 goal-readout term after the clamp so goal-conditioned bias survives even when the legacy dACC path is off.

nodes.name: goal.py
nodes.summary: z_goal persistent goal representation for REE V3: slow-decay attractor in z_world space, incentive-salience token bank (SD-057), and super-ordinal cross-episode goal-anchor store (MECH-189).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses dataclass configs with extensive SD-linked docstring provenance; per-object EMA banks with cross-episode persistence controlled by explicit reset semantics.

nodes.name: GoalConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass parameterizing z_goal attractor dynamics (alpha/decay), drive modulation (SD-012), seeding gates, valence-liking floor, and SD-057 IncentiveTokenBank + MECH-189 SuperOrdinalGoalMemory sub-flags.

nodes.name: SuperOrdinalGoalMemory
nodes.summary: MECH-189 cross-episode cue-indexed goal-anchor store implementing SD-077 common-mode-invariant cue key with centered residual retrieval and reinforce-vs-allocate write policy.

nodes.name: IncentiveTokenBank
nodes.summary: SD-057 per-object incentive-salience token bank; binds benefit to SD-049 resource type, stores per-object base_value + z_object embedding, and computes drive-modulated wanting for cue recall.

nodes.name: GoalState
nodes.summary: Persistent z_goal attractor with EMA update, drive-gated seeding threshold, SD-092 hierarchical parent-goal credit, SD-093 progress-velocity effort modulation, and MECH-188 injection view for scoring.

nodes.name: serotonin.py
nodes.summary: SerotoninModule: MECH-203/204 tonic-5HT state variable + benefit/harm salience tagging, phase-dependent dynamics (waking rise/REM quiescence), and dynamic GoalConfig modulation for balanced replay prioritisation.

nodes.name: SerotoninConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass for SerotoninModule dynamics: baseline, benefit sensitivity, harm suppression, decay rate, phase-specific factors, plus SR-2/SR-3 gains and MECH-204 REM recalibration knobs.

nodes.name: SerotoninModule
nodes.summary: Tonic-5HT scalar state machine with per-phase step dynamics, benefit/harm salience tags (SR-2), REM zero-point capture (SR-3), and MECH-204 target precision recalibration.

nodes.name: structured_curiosity.py
nodes.summary: Pure-arithmetic MECH-314 structured curiosity bonus regulator combining novelty (314a), uncertainty (314b), and learning-progress (314c) sub-flavors into a per-candidate E3 score bias with auto-augmentation streak tracking.
nodes.languageNotes: Sibling-pattern regulator (no nn.Module, no learned params) exposing three independently-togglable sub-flavours for Q-044 ablation; MECH-094 simulation-mode gated.

nodes.name: StructuredCuriosityConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding MECH-314 curiosity master switch, three sub-flavour flags, per-flavour weights, clamp scale, LP EMA/window parameters, and Phase-2 novelty auto-augmentation controls.

nodes.name: StructuredCuriosity
nodes.summary: Pure-arithmetic curiosity regulator that composes MECH-314a novelty, MECH-314b uncertainty, and MECH-314c learning-progress into a clamped per-candidate score bias, honoring MECH-094 simulation-mode gating and tracking auto-augmentation streaks.
nodes.languageNotes: Non-nn.Module regulator with three orthogonally-toggleable channels; state is scalars/ring buffers only; broadcast Phase-1 for 314b/c with per-candidate 314a.

nodes.name: __init__
nodes.summary: Validates all StructuredCuriosityConfig sub-flags, weights, gains, thresholds, and window sizes; raises ValueError on any invalid setting before initializing counters and LP ring buffer.

nodes.name: compute_score_bias
nodes.summary: Main per-tick entry point that dispatches to Phase-2 novelty when enabled, composes weighted MECH-314a/b/c contributions into a K-length bias vector, clamps to +/-bias_scale, and records diagnostic ranges and rail hits.

nodes.name: _compute_novelty_phase2
nodes.summary: Phase-2 novelty computation that consumes coerced RBF centers, monitors candidate spread against the min-spread threshold, updates auto-augmentation streaks, and toggles first-action one-hot augmentation when the streak triggers.

nodes.name: _candidate_spread
nodes.summary: Computes mean pairwise L2 distance across K candidate summaries under no_grad as a scalar spread diagnostic feeding the auto-augmentation streak controller.

nodes.name: _update_augmentation_streak
nodes.summary: Advances or resets the consecutive-low-spread streak counter, flipping first-action one-hot augmentation on when the streak crosses the configured tick threshold.

nodes.name: _coerce_source_to_centers
nodes.summary: Normalizes heterogeneous novelty-source inputs (lists, tensors, arrays) into a detached [N,D] tensor on the target device for Phase-2 novelty processing.

nodes.name: _compute_novelty
nodes.summary: MECH-314a per-candidate novelty via minimum distance from each candidate's first-step z_world to the nearest active RBF center, optionally augmented with first-action one-hots, normalized by mean signature norm.

nodes.name: _compute_uncertainty
nodes.summary: MECH-314b uncertainty scalar read from E3 running variance, broadcast in Phase-1 across candidates and normalized to a nonnegative float.

nodes.name: update_prediction_error
nodes.summary: Feeds a per-tick prediction-error scalar into the MECH-314c learning-progress ring buffer and refreshes the LP EMA of |PE_t - PE_{t-K}|, gated by simulation_mode to protect replay paths.

nodes.name: reset
nodes.summary: Clears LP ring buffer, EMA state, augmentation streak/state, and per-tick diagnostic counters on episode reset.

nodes.name: get_state
nodes.summary: Returns a diagnostic dict of curiosity state including LP buffer size, EMA value, augmentation streak, and per-flavour contribution ranges for downstream logging and Q-044 ablation checks.

nodes.name: OPERATOR_GUIDE.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive operator guide for the Phase 3 coordinator/sync_daemon shadow-coordination system, covering the Explorer coordination panel, three-system architecture (git, coordinator API, sync_daemon writers), five-phase cutover, troubleshooting, hub telemetry transport, and daemon/config drift diagnostics.
nodes.languageNotes: Extensive operator runbook with detailed troubleshooting for hub-writer wedge, daemon code drift, and unit config drift incidents; heavy cross-references to shadow.conf templates, service unit files, and phase3 environment gates.

nodes.name: schema.sql
nodes.summary: SQLite schema for the Phase 3 coordinator database defining five tables (experiments, results, heartbeats, commands, claim_log) plus supporting indexes for pending commands, diverged claims, and experiment status lookups.
nodes.languageNotes: SQLite DDL with INTEGER primary keys, TEXT-typed JSON blobs (progress_json, gpu_json), BLOB manifest_bytes, and CHECK-like status constraints enforced at application layer rather than schema.

nodes.name: experiments
nodes.summary: Canonical queue table mapping queue_id to experiment metadata (script, priority, machine_affinity, status, claim state, supersedes chain) with claimed_by_machine tracking the current owner during Phase 3 coordinator-authoritative claim arbitration.

nodes.name: results
nodes.summary: Result manifest table keyed by run_id storing outcome, manifest bytes as BLOB, and dual timestamps (received_at from runner POST, committed_at when sync_daemon writer materialised the file to git).

nodes.name: heartbeats
nodes.summary: Per-machine liveness telemetry table with current experiment queue_id, JSON-encoded progress and GPU state, elapsed/remaining seconds, and last shutdown timestamp for the coordinator-primary telemetry transport.

nodes.name: commands
nodes.summary: Remote-control command queue for the coordinator-transport command channel with issued_at/acked_at timestamps replacing the legacy per-machine git command files.

nodes.name: claim_log
nodes.summary: Diagnostic append-only log of git-based claim verdicts (agreed/diverged/error) recording queue_id, machine, git verdict, and detail for auditing legacy git-mutex claim arbitration alongside coordinator authoritative claims.

nodes.name: idx_commands_pending
nodes.summary: Partial index on the commands table filtered to unacked rows (acked_at IS NULL) for efficient pending-command polling by machine.

nodes.name: idx_claim_log_diverged
nodes.summary: Index on claim_log for efficient lookup of diverged git-claim verdicts during coordinator-authoritative claim arbitration reconciliation.

nodes.name: idx_experiments_status
nodes.summary: Index on the experiments table status column for efficient filtering of claimable versus terminal experiment rows by phase3_queue_writer materialisation and coordinator claim endpoints.

nodes.name: manifest_spool.py
nodes.summary: Filesystem spool that lets the /result HTTP endpoint persist raw manifest bytes and companion sidefiles keyed on run_id, so the Phase 3 sole-git-writer in sync_daemon.py can later commit them into REE_assembly without touching git from the runner. Every write is atomic-rename with sha256 verification and gated on the COORDINATOR_SPOOL_DIR environment flag; layout is <spool>/pending/<run_id>.json plus <spool>/sidefiles/pending/<run_id>/<relpath>.
nodes.languageNotes: Filesystem-level path safety: every path is verified via resolve().relative_to(root) before touching disk, defending against traversal via crafted run_ids or manifest_relpaths from POST payloads.

nodes.name: sync_daemon.py
nodes.summary: The sole git writer for coordination data in Phase 3: three long-running writer loops (phase3_git_writer for evidence manifests, phase3_queue_writer for experiment_queue.json snapshots from the DB, phase3_heartbeat_writer for runner heartbeat/status telemetry) each own their own repo path and rebase-conflict recovery, with reconcile_once bringing the DB and git queue in sync at startup. Also runs the writer-health persister and telemetry-only autorevert.
nodes.languageNotes: Structured around three writer coroutines sharing a health/heartbeat state module (writer_health) and a fleet of small path/validation helpers. Uses low-level plumbing git (via _git subprocess helper) plus fsync-on-rename in _fsync_dir to survive crashes mid-tick.

nodes.name: test_phase3_sidefile_sync.py
nodes.summary: End-to-end and unit tests for the Phase 3 sidefile spool -> writer round trip: exercises the disabled/roundtrip branches of manifest_spool.py directly and drives sync_daemon's phase3_git_writer through real git repos to verify sidefiles are committed alongside their manifest, quarantined when oversized, and left in the spool when the writer feature flag is off.

nodes.name: spool_root
nodes.summary: Returns the configured COORDINATOR_SPOOL_DIR as a Path, or None when the env var is unset — the master feature switch for all spool writes.

nodes.name: write_manifest
nodes.summary: Atomically writes a manifest and its metadata sidecar for a given run_id: rejects unsafe run_ids, hashes-and-verifies incoming bytes, uses tmp-then-rename with fsync so a crash never leaves a half-file for the writer to consume.

nodes.name: count_pending
nodes.summary: Counts .json files currently sitting in the pending manifest directory — a health-check hook the coordinator exposes to detect backpressure.

nodes.name: list_pending_run_ids
nodes.summary: Enumerates run_ids with pending manifests, deduplicated by pairing .json and .meta.json files, so the writer can process each run atomically.

nodes.name: read_manifest
nodes.summary: Reads the raw manifest bytes for a pending run_id, returning None if either the run_id is unsafe or the file is missing (a caller may have already consumed it).

nodes.name: read_meta
nodes.summary: Reads the JSON metadata sidecar (received_at, sha, optional manifest_relpath hint) accompanying a pending manifest.

nodes.name: delete_manifest
nodes.summary: Removes the manifest and its metadata sidecar after a successful writer commit; tolerates missing files so partial-crash recovery is idempotent.

nodes.name: derive_evidence_relpath
nodes.summary: Resolves where in REE_assembly a manifest should land: prefers the runner-supplied manifest_relpath (validated safe), otherwise falls back to evidence/experiments/<run_id>.json to match the legacy flat layout.

nodes.name: safe_companion_relpath
nodes.summary: Validates a sidefile relative path against traversal and absolute-path attacks before it is used as a filesystem key inside the sidefile spool.

nodes.name: write_sidefile
nodes.summary: Spools a companion sidefile under <spool>/sidefiles/pending/<run_id>/<relpath> using tmp-then-rename with sha256 verification, so the writer can later either commit it alongside its manifest or quarantine it under the oversized threshold.

nodes.name: list_pending_sidefile_run_ids
nodes.summary: Enumerates run_ids that currently have queued sidefiles, so the writer can pair them with their manifest at commit time.

nodes.name: list_sidefiles_for_run
nodes.summary: Recursively lists every sidefile currently spooled for a given run_id along with its safe companion relpath, filtering out any traversal-unsafe entries a partial crash may have left behind.

nodes.name: delete_sidefiles
nodes.summary: Removes every sidefile and metadata for a run and cleans up empty parent directories, called by the writer after a successful commit of the run's sidefile set.

nodes.name: placemarker_relpath_for
nodes.summary: Returns the deterministic relpath under which an oversized-sidefile placemarker is stored — a small JSON stub that lives in git while the real payload sits in cloud storage.

nodes.name: sha256_of_file
nodes.summary: Streams a file through hashlib.sha256 in 1MB chunks to compute a stable content hash without loading the whole payload — used both to verify writes and to fingerprint oversized sidefiles in placemarkers.

nodes.name: build_oversized_sidefile_placemarker
nodes.summary: Constructs the JSON body of an oversized-sidefile placemarker recording the sha, size, oversized threshold, external storage locations, and a note explaining that the real bytes were quarantined off-git.

nodes.name: reconcile_once
nodes.summary: Idempotent DB<->git bootstrapper called at startup: seeds the coordinator's experiments table from the current experiment_queue.json snapshot, optionally reclaiming stale claim rows, so the queue writer can immediately materialise from the DB without re-processing history.

nodes.name: _load_queue_json
nodes.summary: Loads the current experiment_queue.json from disk with defensive error handling — the queue snapshot the reconciler seeds the DB from at startup.

nodes.name: _validate_abs_repo_path
nodes.summary: Validates that an environment-provided repo path is an absolute directory containing a .git entry — refuses relative paths so a misconfigured writer never mutates the wrong tree.

nodes.name: _validate_repo_relpath
nodes.summary: Normalises and safety-checks a repo-relative path from configuration, rejecting absolute paths and .. traversal so the writer's guard checks read a stable, resolvable relpath.

nodes.name: _record_writer_commit
nodes.summary: Updates the per-writer health module with the latest committed subject and repo, so /writer-health can surface last-good state via the coordinator HTTP surface.

nodes.name: _persist_writer_health
nodes.summary: Periodically flushes the in-memory writer-health snapshot to disk so a coordinator restart does not lose last-tick observability data.

nodes.name: _bootstrap_writer_health_from_git
nodes.summary: On startup, walks recent git history for each writer's commit prefix to reconstruct last-known-good state so /writer-health does not read zero after a restart.

nodes.name: _extract_heartbeat_machine_state
nodes.summary: Derives the canonical heartbeat state (start/finish/switch/idle/silent/restart) for a single machine from its combined status and heartbeat DB rows.

nodes.name: _phase3_heartbeat_compute_changes
nodes.summary: Diffs the last-committed per-machine heartbeat state against the current one and emits a change list — the state-change-only signal that eliminated the 30-minute liveness tick and its git-history bloat.

nodes.name: _phase3_heartbeat_phrase
nodes.summary: Formats a single heartbeat state-change event into the human-readable phrase written into commit messages by phase3_heartbeat_writer.

nodes.name: _fsync_dir
nodes.summary: fsync()s a directory so a tmp-then-rename write becomes durable across a crash — used by _atomic_write_text before signalling commit-ready.

nodes.name: _revert_target_to_head
nodes.summary: Runs git checkout HEAD -- <relpath> to undo an unwanted working-tree change on a writer-managed file, part of the telemetry-only autorevert path.

nodes.name: _maybe_revert_exclusive_telemetry_dirt
nodes.summary: Detects the specific case where the only dirty files under a writer's guard are the telemetry files it itself writes, and reverts them so the writer can proceed instead of refusing on a dirty tree.

nodes.name: _restore_derived_path
nodes.summary: Restores a derived (writer-managed) path from the current HEAD when the working tree has diverged — the corrective half of the autorevert loop.

nodes.name: _active_claim_blocks_writer
nodes.summary: Reads TASK_CLAIMS.json to decide whether a writer must yield to an in-flight operator claim on paths it would otherwise commit, avoiding the read-modify-write hazard that would otherwise sweep uncommitted operator edits.

nodes.name: _check_ahead_writer_authored
nodes.summary: Verifies that any local commits ahead of origin were authored by known writer prefixes before rebase, so a stray operator commit is not silently rebased or clobbered.

nodes.name: _sync_to_origin
nodes.summary: The core writer rebase-and-push loop: fetches origin, refuses on non-writer-authored ahead commits, optionally auto-recovers a queue-writer rebase conflict via reset+re-materialise, and pushes only when the ahead range is provably writer-owned.

nodes.name: _load_runpack_builder
nodes.summary: Lazy-imports the runpack-builder from REE_assembly so the sync daemon does not pay for that dependency until the first phase3 run manifest actually needs a per-run pack.

nodes.name: _materialize_runpacks
nodes.summary: For each staged manifest, builds and writes its runs/<run_id>/{manifest,metrics,summary}.json pack alongside the flat manifest, so downstream indexers see a per-run directory as well as the flat file.

nodes.name: _quarantine_oversized_sidefile
nodes.summary: For a sidefile exceeding the size threshold, writes an in-git JSON placemarker (via build_oversized_sidefile_placemarker) and leaves the raw payload in the spool for out-of-band upload, so the git tree never accumulates large binaries.

nodes.name: _materialize_sidefiles
nodes.summary: For each run with pending sidefiles, either copies them into the evidence tree under their manifest's derived directory or quarantines them via a placemarker; wipes the spool entries only after every companion for the run has been placed.

nodes.name: phase3_git_writer
nodes.summary: The evidence-manifest writer loop: drains the manifest spool from manifest_spool.py, materialises runpacks and sidefiles into REE_assembly, commits under the phase3: prefix, and pushes via _sync_to_origin. Refuses on active operator claims covering evidence paths.

nodes.name: _materialise_queue_from_db
nodes.summary: Rebuilds experiment_queue.json from the coordinator's experiments table in canonical order — the DB-authoritative snapshot phase3_queue_writer commits under phase3-queue:.

nodes.name: _warn_on_terminal_drops_without_results
nodes.summary: Logs a WARN when a queue snapshot drops a queue_id that has no results row in the DB — surfaces the burned-queue-entry class of defect that once let /reconcile silently delete uncompleted experiments.

nodes.name: phase3_queue_writer
nodes.summary: The experiment_queue.json writer loop: materialises the queue from the DB each tick, warns on terminal-drop defects, atomically writes and commits with phase3-queue:, and can self-heal a rebase conflict on the queue file via PHASE3_QUEUE_CONFLICT_RECOVERY reset+re-materialise.

nodes.name: _atomic_write_text
nodes.summary: Tmp-file-then-rename+fsync helper used by the queue and heartbeat writers to make sure the file the writer commits is exactly the file it just wrote.

nodes.name: _safe_machine_filename
nodes.summary: Normalises a machine identifier to a safe filesystem name for runner_heartbeats/<machine>.json and runner_status/<machine>.json — the write target the heartbeat writer materialises.

nodes.name: phase3_heartbeat_writer
nodes.summary: The heartbeat and status writer loop: materialises runner_heartbeats/<machine>.json and runner_status/<machine>.json from DB rows, commits state-change deltas under phase3-heartbeats:, and pushes only when the change set is non-empty — replaces the retired 30-minute liveness tick.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point that parses CLI/env config, opens the coordinator DB, runs reconcile_once, then starts the three writer threads (git, queue, heartbeat) plus the health persister; ties SIGTERM into a clean shutdown.

nodes.name: SidefileSpoolDisabledTest
nodes.summary: Asserts that with the sidefile spool feature flag off, every write/read/list helper in manifest_spool.py is a no-op or returns empty — the bit-identical disabled-path guarantee.

nodes.name: SidefileSpoolRoundtripTest
nodes.summary: Unit-level round-trip tests for manifest_spool.py's sidefile API: write+list+read+delete for single and multi-companion runs, idempotent overwrite, rejection of unsafe relpaths and run_ids, and the safe_companion_relpath helper.

nodes.name: WriterSidefileE2ETest
nodes.summary: End-to-end tests driving sync_daemon's phase3_git_writer through real bare-remote+clone git repos: verifies flag-on manifest+sidefile land in a single commit, flag-off sidefiles are not committed, late-arriving companions are folded into a subsequent commit, oversized sidefiles are quarantined via placemarker, and mixed-run oversized companions do not wipe the wrong spool.

nodes.name: ClientEnvelopeTest
nodes.summary: Verifies that a client-side envelope carrying manifest+sidefile bytes decodes and lands correctly in the spool via manifest_spool.py's write helpers.

nodes.name: RunnerHelperTest
nodes.summary: Tests the runner-side helpers that collect declared and autodiscovered companion files under a manifest's derived directory, guarding against boundary leakage, subdirectory recursion, unrelated-sibling capture, and self-inclusion of the manifest.

nodes.name: agent.py
nodes.summary: Central REEAgent module — the ~11.8k-line top-level cognitive-architecture agent that assembles perception, prediction (E1/E2/E3), affective residue, hippocampal navigation, PFC control, sleep consolidation, and actor-critic learning into a single V3 substrate. Wires ~43 brain-region-named submodules via dependency injection in __init__.
nodes.languageNotes: Single nn.Module subclass with 95 methods and heavy use of getattr for optional-substrate probes; ~11k non-empty lines.

nodes.name: candidate_support_preflight
nodes.summary: Module-level preflight that inspects proposed action candidates and per-class score biases before selection, returning a support map used to guard degenerate cases.

nodes.name: _resolve_chunk_deliberation_horizon
nodes.summary: Resolves the deliberation horizon the MECH-323 growable chunk ceiling derives from, using the agent config as input.

nodes.name: AgentState
nodes.summary: Dataclass snapshot of the complete REE-v3 agent state at a timestep: latent, precision, running variance, harm accumulator, commitment flag, beta-gate state, E3 iteration count, and optional serotonergic state.

nodes.name: REEAgent
nodes.summary: Reflective-Ethical Engine V3 agent — the top-level nn.Module composing all brain-region-analog substrates (E1/E2/E3 predictors, hippocampal navigation, PFC/OFC/frontopolar, amygdala, PAG, cingulate, residue field, goal state, actor-critic, sleep) and enforcing the V3 invariants (persistent ethical cost, world-delta residue, harm-eval on z_world, motor-sensory E2 training).
nodes.languageNotes: Inherits from torch.nn.Module; 95 methods spanning constructor, perception (sense/sense_flat), policy (select_action/act), learning (compute_*_loss, actor_critic_step), navigation (update_z_goal), and sleep (run_sws/rem_pass).

nodes.name: __init__
nodes.summary: Constructor that instantiates and wires ~40 brain-region submodules (predictors, PFC/OFC/hippocampus/amygdala/PAG, residue field, goal state, comparators, serotonin, sleep, actor-critic) from an REEConfig, gated by many optional-substrate flags.

nodes.name: from_config
nodes.summary: Classmethod factory that constructs an REEAgent from a config object, resolving dimensions and defaults before delegating to __init__.

nodes.name: reset
nodes.summary: Episode-boundary reset that clears per-episode state (goal, residue, hippocampal, exploration record, comparator caches) while preserving learned parameters.

nodes.name: sense
nodes.summary: Perception step ingesting an observation dict, running the E1/E2 encoders and updating latent state, residue, and object-file buffer; the main upstream entry into a policy tick.

nodes.name: sense_flat
nodes.summary: Flat-observation variant of sense() for environments emitting a single tensor rather than a dict — routes through the same encoder pipeline with default channel splits.

nodes.name: select_action
nodes.summary: Main policy inference: enumerates candidate actions, scores them through E3 (harm/benefit evaluator) and E2 (motor-sensory predictor), applies frontopolar/PFC gating and beta modulation, and returns the selected action plus diagnostics.

nodes.name: act
nodes.summary: High-level tick combining sense+select_action for a single environment step; returns the chosen action for the runner.

nodes.name: act_with_split_obs
nodes.summary: act() variant that accepts split-observation tensors (proprio/extero separated) — used by experiments that instrument the observation split.

nodes.name: act_with_log_prob
nodes.summary: act() variant that additionally returns the action log-probability under the current policy, for actor-critic training and importance weighting.

nodes.name: forward
nodes.summary: nn.Module.forward implementation — dispatches through the sense-then-select_action pipeline so the agent can be used as an ordinary torch module.

nodes.name: get_state
nodes.summary: Returns the current AgentState snapshot (latent, precision, running variance, harm, commitment, beta-elevation, E3 steps, serotonin) for external logging and diagnostics.

nodes.name: generate_trajectories
nodes.summary: Rolls out candidate trajectories via the E2 world model — used by the deliberation horizon expansion and MECH-323 growable chunking.

nodes.name: update_object_file_buffer
nodes.summary: Ingests EntityObservations from the current sense-step into the ObjectFileBuffer, maintaining persistent per-entity slots for the object-representation thread.

nodes.name: update_residue
nodes.summary: Updates the persistent residue field from world-delta (z_world change) — implements V3 invariant that ethical cost is persistent and tracks world change, not body state.

nodes.name: update_z_goal
nodes.summary: Updates the current z_goal (goal latent) via the hippocampal module and super-ordinal writer, gated by write-enable and beta-gate release state.

nodes.name: record_transition
nodes.summary: Records the (state, action, next_state, reward, done) transition into the agent's per-episode buffers used by actor-critic, replay, and offline integration.

nodes.name: update_cross_stream_binder
nodes.summary: Updates the cross-stream binder that ties latent streams across E1/E2/E3 and the residue field.

nodes.name: compute_prediction_loss
nodes.summary: Computes the E1/E2 predictive loss over recorded transitions — the core self-supervised objective for the world/self models.

nodes.name: compute_benefit_eval_loss
nodes.summary: Computes the loss for the benefit-evaluator head on z_world targets — E3 benefit-side supervision.

nodes.name: compute_event_contrastive_loss
nodes.summary: Contrastive loss between event embeddings, supporting event-segmented representation learning.

nodes.name: compute_resource_proximity_loss
nodes.summary: Loss shaping the resource-proximity readout used by the hippocampal navigation head.

nodes.name: compute_resource_encoder_loss
nodes.summary: Supervises the resource encoder used by the resource-proximity and identity heads.

nodes.name: compute_resource_identity_loss
nodes.summary: Identity-classification loss for the resource identity head; disambiguates resource types across contexts.

nodes.name: compute_harm_nonredundancy_loss
nodes.summary: Enforces non-redundancy between the two harm-side E2 heads (harm_a and harm_s), preventing collapse to a single channel.

nodes.name: compute_harm_accum_loss
nodes.summary: Loss on the harm-suffering accumulator's regression, supervising accumulated-harm predictions.

nodes.name: compute_schema_readout_loss
nodes.summary: Loss on the schema-wanting readout, tying wanting signals to schema activation.

nodes.name: compute_self_maintenance_loss
nodes.summary: Loss maintaining z_self stability against motor-sensory prediction targets — implements V3 invariant #4 (E2 on motor-sensory error).

nodes.name: compute_e2_loss
nodes.summary: Aggregate E2 predictor loss across its heads (fast, world, harm_a, harm_s).

nodes.name: compute_goal_maintenance_diagnostic
nodes.summary: Diagnostic-only computation of goal-maintenance quality; feeds instrumentation panels rather than gradients.

nodes.name: actor_critic_step
nodes.summary: One actor-critic optimization step over the recorded transition buffer — applies gradients to the policy/value heads.

nodes.name: actor_critic_reward
nodes.summary: Computes the actor-critic reward signal from residue-adjusted extrinsic reward plus intrinsic terms.

nodes.name: serotonin_step
nodes.summary: Advances the serotonergic neuromodulator per MECH-203/204 — updates tonic level from persistence appraisal and modulates downstream gating.

nodes.name: offline_integration
nodes.summary: Offline-mode integration pass consolidating recent experience without emitting actions — the entry point for the sleep/consolidation subsystem.

nodes.name: run_sws_schema_pass
nodes.summary: SWS (slow-wave sleep) analog pass consolidating schemas via the hippocampal replay + latent stack — supports INV-049 sleep-necessity claim.

nodes.name: run_rem_attribution_pass
nodes.summary: REM analog pass that re-attributes recent experience via the scientist attribution buffer and BLA remap heads.

nodes.name: run_sleep_cycle
nodes.summary: Runs a full SWS+REM sleep cycle, orchestrating enter/exit mode transitions around the two consolidation passes.

nodes.name: enter_sws_mode
nodes.summary: Transitions the agent into SWS mode — disables online policy tick and enables the schema-replay code path.

nodes.name: enter_rem_mode
nodes.summary: Transitions the agent into REM mode — enables the attribution-remap code path.

nodes.name: exit_sleep_mode
nodes.summary: Restores the agent's online-tick mode after a sleep cycle completes.

nodes.name: notify_env_completion
nodes.summary: External notification hook the runner calls when an environment episode terminates — flushes exploration episodes, records task outcome, and clears per-episode buffers.

nodes.name: notify_subgoal_attainment
nodes.summary: External notification hook indicating a sub-goal was attained — updates the incentive-token bank and goal state.

nodes.name: _update_blocked_agency
nodes.summary: Internal update of the BlockedAgency module tracking cases where an intended action is blocked, which feeds suffering and residue.

nodes.name: _update_scientist_attribution
nodes.summary: Internal update of the scientist attribution buffer that records per-region contribution traces used by the REM attribution pass.

nodes.name: _e1_tick
nodes.summary: Per-tick advance of the E1 deep predictor over the current latent state.

nodes.name: _e3_tick
nodes.summary: Per-tick advance of the E3 harm/benefit evaluator, producing scores over candidate world outcomes.

nodes.name: _compute_persistence_appraisal
nodes.summary: Computes the persistence appraisal driving serotonergic modulation and hippocampal ghost-goal reactivation.

nodes.name: _assemble_control_vector
nodes.summary: Assembles the control-vector conditioning input for the policy from the current goal, residue, serotonin, and beta-gate state.

nodes.name: _curiosity_per_candidate_uncertainty
nodes.summary: Per-candidate epistemic uncertainty used by the curiosity term — feeds action selection's exploration bonus.

nodes.name: _flush_exploration_episode
nodes.summary: Flushes recorded exploration-episode state to the exploration buffer at episode boundaries.

nodes.name: theta_buffer.py
nodes.summary: ThetaBuffer implements cross-rate integration for MECH-089/SD-006, giving E3 temporally-averaged theta-cycle summaries of z_world/z_self instead of raw per-tick E1/E2 output. Supports SD-100 phase-weighted summaries and MECH-122 consolidation-mode packaging.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure PyTorch scalar/tensor arithmetic, no nn.Module; uses collections.deque as the rolling backing store.

nodes.name: ThetaBuffer
nodes.summary: Rolling theta-cycle buffer that tracks recent z_world/z_self estimates from E1 and produces theta-cycle summaries (flat mean, phase-weighted, or consolidation-mode packaging) consumed by E3 at heartbeat ticks.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package init for the PAG (periaqueductal gray) substrate; re-exports the MECH-279 committed-freeze gate and MECH-489/SD-099 defensive-orienting gate from their submodules.

nodes.name: e1_deep.py
nodes.summary: E1 deep-predictor module implementing long-horizon LSTM prediction over latent state, cue-indexed ContextMemory attention (SD-016), schema-salience readout (MECH-216), and SHY synaptic homeostasis (MECH-120) for waking rollouts feeding E3.
nodes.languageNotes: Extensive use of getattr(config, ...) fallbacks so newer SD flags stay bit-identical when absent; multiple togglable sub-heads (cue-slot tagger with soft/gumbel/topk selection modes).

nodes.name: ContextMemory
nodes.summary: Cue-indexed slot memory with query/key/value attention read, gated writes into the slot with the weakest current match, and an off-diagonal cosine diversification loss to encourage slot orthogonality.

nodes.name: E1DeepPredictor
nodes.summary: Recurrent E1 predictor that generates long-horizon z_world rollouts via an LSTM transition model, produces cue-driven action/terrain biases through ContextMemory attention (SD-016 with soft/Gumbel/top-k selection variants), and exposes schema-salience readouts for anticipatory wanting (MECH-216).

nodes.name: salience_coordinator.py
nodes.summary: SD-032a salience-network coordinator: aggregates dACC bundle plus homeostatic/offline signals into a soft operating-mode probability vector with Schmitt-trigger hysteresis, MECH-259 mode-switch trigger, and the MECH-261 dict-keyed write-gate registry.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure-arithmetic regulator (no nn.Module, no learned parameters); non-trainable dataclass-config module with softmax mode-probability computation, MECH-266 asymmetric per-mode enter/exit thresholds, and MECH-048 mu/kappa temperature overlays.

nodes.name: SalienceCoordinatorConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding SalienceCoordinator tunables: mode affinity weights, external-task bias, softmax temperature, MECH-048 stability-temperature overlays, MECH-266 per-mode enter/exit hysteresis thresholds, salience-signal weights, and affinity input cap.

nodes.name: SalienceCoordinator
nodes.summary: Network-level coordinator that ticks the mode-probability softmax, applies Schmitt-trigger hysteresis (MECH-266) to derive current_mode, exposes mode-conditioned write_gate values (MECH-261 registry), and emits switch triggers when salience aggregate crosses per-mode enter thresholds while current mode falls below its exit rail.

nodes.name: tick
nodes.summary: Core per-cycle update: consumes dACC bundle plus registered signals, folds SD-057 per-axis-drive into external-task affinity, computes mode-probability softmax with MECH-048 mu/kappa effective-temperature overlays, and applies MECH-266 asymmetric enter/exit rails to fire mode-switch triggers.

nodes.name: module.py
nodes.summary: Hippocampal module orchestrating episodic memory: composes anchor set, event segmenter, ghost-goal bank, staleness accumulator, invalidation trigger, and residue field into REE's hippocampal subsystem.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-class module (HippocampalModule) with 69 methods and ~3.5k lines — a large god-class typical of REE's cognitive subsystems that coordinate many collaborators.

nodes.name: HippocampalModule
nodes.summary: Central hippocampal orchestrator that wires anchors, event segmentation, ghost goals, staleness accumulation, and invalidation broadcasts against the residue field and E2 fast predictor.

nodes.name: e3_selector.py
nodes.summary: E3 trajectory selector: the deliberative slow predictor that scores candidate trajectories, applies noisy selection heads, and commits an action from goal-conditioned samples.
nodes.languageNotes: torch.multinomial call sites here are the load-bearing point of the cross-machine-class contract divergence (Mac vs. cloud sampling drift).

nodes.name: SelectionResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass carrying the outcome of one E3 selection cycle (chosen trajectory, scores, commitment metadata).

nodes.name: E3TrajectorySelector
nodes.summary: Slow E3 predictor that consumes E2 trajectories, applies noisy selection heads and goal-conditioned scoring, and produces the committed action + telemetry the agent acts on.

nodes.name: project_channel_range
nodes.summary: Projects a feature tensor onto a declared channel range, used to slice E2/E3 feature payloads for selection heads.

nodes.name: variance_commit_threshold
nodes.summary: Derives the variance-based commit threshold from the configured value used by the E3 selector's commit gate.

nodes.name: field.py
nodes.summary: Residue field: RBF-layer-backed distributed representation of residual salience/care markers consumed by hippocampal and predictor modules.

nodes.name: RBFLayer
nodes.summary: Radial basis function layer used inside the residue field to embed and read out spatial/latent residues.

nodes.name: ResidueField
nodes.summary: Residue field: distributed store of residual signals (care markers, mood, salience) built on RBFLayer, read by the hippocampal module and the E3 selector.

nodes.name: mel_consumer.py
nodes.summary: SD-MEL-CONSUMER (sleep_substrate GAP-5b) adaptive sleep-cadence controller that reads accumulated waking Model Error Load (MEL) and modulates SWS/REM sleep-phase duration and entry timing. Implements INV-050's learning-demand sleep drive as a pure-arithmetic regulator over the SD-017 sleep cycle.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure-arithmetic dataclass-based regulator, no torch/nn.Module dependencies, single-module implementation of a load-bearing V3 substrate.

nodes.name: MELConsumerConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass configuration for the MEL consumer, mirrored on REEConfig. Holds knobs for gain, reference-tracking mode, duration-factor bounds, per-phase scaling, and entry-timing threshold.

nodes.name: WakingMELAccumulator
nodes.summary: Streaming accumulator for per-step E3 prediction error magnitudes across a waking window. Filters non-finite inputs and exposes running mean/count with reset semantics.

nodes.name: MELConsumer
nodes.summary: Adaptive sleep-cadence regulator: accumulates waking MEL, tracks an EMA/fixed reference, computes a clamped duration factor scaling SWS/REM passes, and gates entry via a relative-novelty threshold. Emits diagnostics for cadence attribution.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure-arithmetic; relative-response design (mel/ref, never absolute) with a small floor to guard div-by-zero; MECH-094 gated at caller.

nodes.name: phase_manager.py
nodes.summary: SleepLoopManager: deterministic K-episode driver for the SD-017 sleep cycle plus the sleep_substrate GAP-9 within-life step trigger. Composes the Phase B-E consumers (replay sampler, routing gate, Bayesian aggregator, self-model aggregator, MEL consumer, cross-module consolidator) into a single cycle orchestrator.
nodes.languageNotes: Long orchestrator class (~700 lines) with heavy conditional wiring of optional Phase B-E consumers; welfare_relevant marker denotes offline harm-content resampling.

nodes.name: SleepPhase
nodes.summary: Enum of canonical sleep-cycle phases (WAKING, SLEEP_ENTRY, SWS_ANALOG, PHASE_SWITCH, REM_ANALOG, WRITEBACK). Reserves intermediate tokens for Phase D aggregator and Phase E writeback.

nodes.name: SleepCycleState
nodes.summary: Per-cycle bookkeeping dataclass: cycle index, current phase, episodes/steps since last sleep, and last-cycle metrics. Reset at the start of each sleep cycle.

nodes.name: SleepLoopManager
nodes.summary: Central sleep-cycle driver: increments per-episode/per-step counters, fires the SD-017 cycle via K-episode cadence, MEL entry-timing, or within-life step ceiling, and orchestrates Phase B-E consumers (replay sampler, routing gate, Bayesian aggregators, MEL consumer, cross-module consolidator, MECH-204 precision writeback).
nodes.languageNotes: The `_run_cycle` method is the load-bearing method (~350 lines) composing every optional Phase B-E consumer, extract-region tagging, evidence lookup, and MECH-204 precision recalibration.

nodes.name: _run_cycle
nodes.summary: Core sleep-cycle orchestrator: gates on SD-017 substrate presence and MECH-286 sleep-onset permit, drives SWS then REM passes through the replay sampler / routing gate / Bayesian + self-model aggregators, applies MECH-204 precision recalibration + MECH-273 partial staleness decay, and merges per-cycle metrics.

nodes.name: notify_waking_step
nodes.summary: sleep_substrate GAP-9 within-life sleep trigger. Called once per waking step from REEAgent.update_residue; fires a sleep cycle when accumulated MEL crosses the entry threshold (design (b) primary) or the within-life step ceiling is hit (design (a) backstop). Records arm-attribution diagnostics.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the SD-035 amygdala analogue substrate; re-exports the two non-trainable peer modules (BLA and CeA) plus the trainable BLA attribution head. Documents the biological division between basolateral encoding_gain / retrieval_bias / remap_signal outputs and central mode_prior / fast_prime outputs, both consuming z_harm_a from the affective harm stream.
nodes.languageNotes: Python package __init__.py acting as a public API surface via explicit __all__ export list.

nodes.name: phase3_preflight.py
nodes.summary: Phase-3 pre-cutover precondition checks for the REE coordinator: validates coordinator.env, schema, sync_daemon readiness, fleet lifecycle state, and per-host SSH probes before the operator authorises the git-writer cutover.
nodes.languageNotes: ASCII-only stdout by contract; standalone CLI with three exit codes (0 pass, 1 fail, 2 config error).

nodes.name: CheckResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding a single preflight check's outcome: check_id, category, status (PASS/FAIL/SKIP/WARN), message, and structured detail dict.

nodes.name: _evaluate_fleet_lifecycle
nodes.summary: Adjudicates fleet lifecycle readiness against the /shadow/status payload: matches expected peers via canonical_machine_name so macOS LocalHostName drift does not split identities, and accepts ree-cloud-4 as gracefully_offline outside a cutover window.

nodes.name: run_preflight
nodes.summary: Top-level orchestrator: loads coordinator.env, probes shadow HTTP endpoint, DB schema, sync_daemon readiness, fleet lifecycle, and per-host SSH liveness, aggregating CheckResults for the report + exit-code logic.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point: parses --dry-run/--json/--env-file flags, invokes run_preflight, prints the human or JSON report, and returns the exit code convention documented in the module header.

nodes.name: phase3_verify.py
nodes.summary: Phase-3 post-cutover verification: runs a battery of checks confirming the sync_daemon is the sole git writer for coordination artifacts, workers no longer push, telemetry is derived from the DB, and no foreign commits contaminate the writer's history.
nodes.languageNotes: ASCII-only stdout; supports --dry-run/--json/--mock/--expect-cutover for CI and headless invocation.

nodes.name: _classify_commits
nodes.summary: Partitions a list of commit subject lines into writer-authored and foreign buckets using the WRITER_COMMIT_PREFIXES tuple; pure helper, unit-tested.

nodes.name: check_sync_daemon_phase3_tick
nodes.summary: Verifies the sync_daemon is running Phase-3 tick logic by SSH-inspecting recent journalctl output for the gate line + phase3 tick evidence rather than only a stub startup message.

nodes.name: check_hub_git_writer_only
nodes.summary: Enforces that recent REE_assembly commits carry only WRITER_COMMIT_PREFIXES; a single foreign commit fails the check because it means an operator or worker is still contaminating the writer's coordination-plane history.

nodes.name: check_workers_no_result_git_push
nodes.summary: Confirms every worker (cloud + local Mac) has the PHASE3 result/queue/heartbeat push-disable environment set in its runner drop-in, and reads recent runner logs to catch any residual push attempts.

nodes.name: check_derived_heartbeats
nodes.summary: Checks that runner_heartbeats/*.json files on origin/master are recent AND authored by the sync_daemon phase3-heartbeats writer (not a stale worker-side push), covering the state-change-only commit cadence.

nodes.name: run_verify
nodes.summary: Orchestrator that sequences every phase3 check (sync_daemon tick, git-writer exclusivity, worker push-off, heartbeat retirement, results drained, queue snapshot fresh, derived heartbeats), aggregating results into a report.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry: parses --dry-run/--json/--mock/--expect-cutover, invokes run_verify, prints report, and returns the documented exit-code convention.

nodes.name: causal_grid_world.py
nodes.summary: The primary REE V3 grid-world environment (CausalGridWorld / CausalGridWorldV2 alias): 2D world with body/world observation split (SD-005), proxy gradient fields for harm and benefit (SD-010/SD-011), landmark cues (SD-023), effort dissociation (Q-080), and dozens of experiment-only knobs stacking substrate builds SD-022/029/047/048/049/054/057/065/094 for the causal-grid experiment lineage.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately monolithic to keep every substrate landing bit-identical when its master flag is off; new features are added exclusively via env-only constructor kwargs that never flow through REEConfig.from_dims (matches the SD-022/023/029/047/048/049/054/065 precedent).

nodes.name: CausalGridWorld
nodes.summary: Central 2D grid environment class with a body_state/world_state observation split, per-tick harm/benefit gradient fields, contamination dynamics, landmark cues, effort corridors, reef/bipartite layouts, resource type heterogeneity, scheduled hazard/limb-damage injection, sleep drivers, and an alias CausalGridWorldV2 that just sets use_proxy_fields=True by default.
nodes.languageNotes: ~5000 lines; every new feature is a no-op-default env kwarg. Class attributes ACTIONS (dict), CONSUME_ACTION (const), ENTITY_TYPES (dict) act as the public grid vocabulary.

nodes.name: CausalGridWorldV2
nodes.summary: Factory function alias: constructs CausalGridWorld with use_proxy_fields=True by default so callers get the SD-010/SD-011 harm/benefit gradient channels without repeating the flag; preserves every explicit kwarg override.

nodes.name: app.py
nodes.summary: Phase-3 coordinator HTTP service (ThreadingHTTPServer) exposing bearer-authenticated GET/POST endpoints for experiment claim arbitration, heartbeats, result manifest ingestion, and command dispatch across the cloud worker fleet.
nodes.languageNotes: Stdlib-only HTTP server (no framework); Handler subclasses BaseHTTPRequestHandler and routes by path in do_GET/do_POST dispatch.

nodes.name: db.py
nodes.summary: SQLite persistence layer for the Phase-3 coordinator: schema migrations, claim state machine (claim/release/reap/departure), heartbeat/status upserts, results and commands. Sole authoritative source of experiment claim state across the fleet.
nodes.languageNotes: Stdlib sqlite3 with manual migrations (_migrate_* helpers); UTC timestamps stringly-typed via _parse_utc; claim recovery has TWO orthogonal routes (time-based staleness + departure notice) documented at length in the parent CLAUDE.md.

nodes.name: test_phase3_runpack_materialize.py
nodes.summary: unittest suite for the sync_daemon runpack materialization path: verifies flat manifest -> per-run pack conversion, staging into REE_assembly via git, provenance carry-through, and default-off flag behaviour.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a scratch git repo under tempfile.mkdtemp; four TestCase classes cover golden-byte, materialize workflow, field mapping, and default-flag.

nodes.name: Handler
nodes.summary: BaseHTTPRequestHandler subclass implementing every coordinator HTTP endpoint (claim/release, queue snapshot, heartbeat/status, shutdown notice, fence clear, command issue/fetch/ack, result manifest + sidefile POST, writer health, machines dashboard). Enforces bearer-token auth on every non-liveness path.

nodes.name: _canon
nodes.summary: Canonicalises a machine identifier via canonical_machine_name (with a small hardcoded fallback), guarding against the DLAPTOP-4/DLAPTOP-5 macOS Bonjour suffix drift that would otherwise split one laptop into two coordinator identities.

nodes.name: _read_writer_health
nodes.summary: Reads the sync_daemon writer-health JSON snapshot from disk (if present), returning an empty dict on any read/parse failure so the /writer-health endpoint stays best-effort.

nodes.name: _age_out_errors
nodes.summary: Strips stale error records (older than a caller-supplied cutoff) from the writer-health snapshot in place, preventing long-resolved failures from polluting the operator dashboard.

nodes.name: auth_machine
nodes.summary: Constant-time bearer-token verifier (hmac.compare_digest) that maps an Authorization header to the machine name the token was issued for, returning None on any failure so unauthenticated requests uniformly get rejected.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses hmac.compare_digest to defeat timing attacks on token comparison.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Coordinator service entry point: initialises the SQLite DB, loads bearer tokens, binds a ThreadingHTTPServer on the configured host/port, and serves forever until interrupted.

nodes.name: _migrate_experiments
nodes.summary: Adds newer columns (item_json, machine_affinity, priority, ...) to the experiments table if absent, keeping legacy coordinator DBs upgradeable in place.

nodes.name: _migrate_heartbeats
nodes.summary: Additive schema migration for the heartbeats table, appending shutdown/fence/process-exit columns as they were introduced by later phase-3 features so older DB files keep working.

nodes.name: _migrate_commands
nodes.summary: Creates the commands table (id, machine, kind, args, issued_by, issued_at, acked_at, result_status, result_note) if missing so remote-control command channel state has a home.

nodes.name: _affinity_ok
nodes.summary: Machine-affinity matcher used by claim gating: treats 'any' / empty as wildcard, otherwise resolves both sides through machine_identity.same_machine so DLAPTOP-4/DLAPTOP-5 do not appear as different boxes.

nodes.name: upsert_experiment
nodes.summary: Insert-or-update path for the experiments table that preserves an already-active claim (preserve_claim=True) when re-materialising the queue snapshot, preventing the phase3 queue writer from silently clobbering a live claim.

nodes.name: _parse_utc
nodes.summary: Parses a stringly-typed UTC ISO timestamp (accepts both 'Z' and offset forms) into a timezone-aware datetime, returning None on any parse failure so callers can treat missing/malformed timestamps uniformly.

nodes.name: _has_fresh_owner_heartbeat
nodes.summary: Guard used by the claim-recovery predicate: returns True when the machine currently claiming a queue_id has posted a recent heartbeat AGAINST THAT queue_id, so a still-running claim is never reaped as stale.

nodes.name: _claim_recoverable
nodes.summary: Two-route claim-recovery predicate (route a: time-staleness with no fresh owner heartbeat; route b: machine announced shutdown and has since been quiet), the sole gate for reassigning an already-claimed experiment.
nodes.languageNotes: Route (b) added 2026-07-30 to cut V3-EXQ-841 orphan recovery from ~10h to ~20min without lowering the 6h staleness floor; see CLAUDE.md for the safety rationale.

nodes.name: claim_fence_active
nodes.summary: Pure predicate that returns True while a per-machine claim fence is still in effect (established by a graceful shutdown of a specific reason class and not yet cleared or timed out), preventing a rebooting worker from immediately re-claiming.

nodes.name: machine_claim_fenced
nodes.summary: DB-facing wrapper around claim_fence_active that reads the machine's heartbeat row and returns True iff the machine is currently claim-fenced.

nodes.name: record_claim_fence_clear
nodes.summary: Records a claim-fence clearing event on a machine's heartbeat row (either a live handshake or a new-boot marker) so the fence predicate flips to inactive.

nodes.name: machine_departed
nodes.summary: Pure predicate for the 'gracefully departed and stayed quiet' state -- a machine that announced a non-process shutdown reason and has since been silent longer than quiet_seconds. Positive signal used by route (b) of claim recovery to bypass the 6h staleness floor safely.
nodes.languageNotes: Excludes runner_signal_exit / runner_drain_complete reasons on purpose -- both cases already released their claims on the way out.

nodes.name: machine_has_departed
nodes.summary: DB-facing wrapper around machine_departed: reads the machine's heartbeat row and returns True iff the machine announced shutdown and has since gone quiet past the reap threshold.

nodes.name: claim_orphaned_by_departure
nodes.summary: Helper used inside _claim_recoverable: returns True when the machine currently claiming a queue_id has departed and been quiet longer than reap_quiet_seconds -- the recoverable-by-departure route.

nodes.name: try_claim
nodes.summary: Coordinator-authoritative claim primitive: BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction that checks affinity, fence, and existing claim state, atomically writes the claimed_by/claimed_at fields when eligible, and returns the outcome verdict. Sole entry point for /claim from workers.

nodes.name: evaluate_claim
nodes.summary: Read-only claim evaluator: mirrors try_claim's decision logic without mutating state so the coord verdict can be compared to the git-side legacy claim verdict for divergence tracking.

nodes.name: apply_git_outcome
nodes.summary: Applies a git-side claim outcome to the DB row (used during the transitional dual-write period when git commits and coordinator authority co-existed), keyed on queue_id.

nodes.name: release_claim
nodes.summary: Releases a claim held by the given machine, reverting the row to pending. Idempotent; refuses to release a claim owned by a different machine so a hostile or misconfigured worker cannot yank someone else's work.

nodes.name: mark_queue_removed
nodes.summary: Terminal-state helper that marks a queue_id row as removed with an audit reason, used when phase3_queue_writer materialises the git-side queue snapshot and finds an entry deleted upstream.

nodes.name: claim_verdicts_diverge
nodes.summary: Detects a genuine divergence between the git-side claim verdict and the coordinator verdict for a given claim attempt, ignoring explained-difference cases (schema-known race patterns).

nodes.name: divergence_stats
nodes.summary: Aggregates the claim_log divergence table into total/explained/unexplained counts for the operator health dashboard.

nodes.name: log_claim
nodes.summary: Appends a claim attempt to the claim_log audit table with both git-side and coordinator verdicts + any detail, precomputing the divergence flag so downstream queries stay cheap.

nodes.name: record_result
nodes.summary: Inserts a completed run's result row (run_id keyed) with the manifest bytes and sha256, deduplicating repeated POSTs of the same run_id so a worker retry does not corrupt the DB.

nodes.name: upsert_heartbeat
nodes.summary: Insert-or-update a machine's heartbeats row with the latest state / current EXQ / progress payload / GPU info / elapsed / remaining, updating last_seen. Sole write path for runner heartbeat POSTs; feeds the git materialiser downstream.

nodes.name: record_status_payload
nodes.summary: Records the runner's full status payload (large JSON) into the heartbeats row's payload_json column, used by /shadow/status for high-fidelity operator views.

nodes.name: record_shutdown_notice
nodes.summary: Records a graceful shutdown notice (reason + expected wake condition + timing), updating both the last_shutdown_at and per-reason process/machine exit fields used by claim_fence_active, machine_departed, and lifecycle_state.

nodes.name: announced_offline_at
nodes.summary: Returns the most recent 'announced offline' timestamp across last_shutdown_at and last_process_exit_at, tolerating None on either side. Used to compute lifecycle_state.

nodes.name: lifecycle_state
nodes.summary: Classifies a machine's current lifecycle state from its heartbeat row: live / stale / gracefully_offline / silent, honouring the ordering constraint that a machine is only gracefully_offline if its shutdown notice is the most recent event.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately NOT reused inside _claim_recoverable route (b) because a draining box keeps heartbeating for ~26min and would misclassify as stale; see CLAUDE.md.

nodes.name: insert_command
nodes.summary: Inserts a remote-control command for a machine and returns the full row dict, giving the operator API a one-call issue-and-echo path.

nodes.name: ack_command
nodes.summary: Runner-side command ack: stamps acked_at, result_status, and result_note on the command row, refusing to ack a command belonging to a different machine so a spoof cannot silently drain another worker's queue.

nodes.name: GoldenByteShape
nodes.summary: Regression harness that pins the exact per-run pack bytes (manifest, metrics, summary) generated from an EXQ-633 flat manifest, guarding against silent format drift in sync_v3_results.runpack_for_flat.

nodes.name: MaterializeRunpacks
nodes.summary: End-to-end unittest for sync_daemon._materialize_runpacks: constructs a scratch git repo under tempfile, writes flat manifests, invokes the backfill, and asserts pack files were created, staged, and are idempotent under re-run.

nodes.name: FieldMappingProvenance
nodes.summary: Unit tests for sync_v3_results.build_runpack_docs field mapping: provenance keys carry into the pack, absent keys are omitted (not nulled), aggregates fold when top-level metrics missing, and top-level metrics take precedence when both present.

nodes.name: _resolve_ree_assembly
nodes.summary: Locates the REE_assembly checkout (honouring an env override) for the tests that need to reach into a real git worktree for the sync_daemon materialization path.

nodes.name: _make_flat
nodes.summary: Fixture builder that returns a minimal but sync_daemon-eligible flat manifest dict (run_id, experiment_type, epoch, claim_ids, outcome, criteria), used across the materialization and field-mapping tests.

nodes.name: infralimbic_avoidance_gate.py
nodes.summary: Implements MECH-357 / SD-058: an infralimbic-PFC analogue that suppresses PAG-driven freezing and biases E3 candidate selection so an instrumental avoidance action can be released and its efficacy learned via a per-agent eligibility trace.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure-arithmetic regulator (no nn.Module, no learned parameters); uses torch tensors only to shape the per-candidate score bias vector fed back into the E3 selector.

nodes.name: InstrumentalAvoidanceGateConfig
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass holding eligibility-trace, threat-scaling, scaffold-floor and action-bias parameters for the MECH-357 gate; defaults yield backward-compatible no-op behaviour at rest.

nodes.name: InstrumentalAvoidanceGateOutput
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass returned as a snapshot of the last gate tick — carries learned/effective avoidance efficacy, threat scale, freeze-suppression scalar, and bias magnitude for diagnostics.

nodes.name: InstrumentalAvoidanceGate
nodes.summary: Non-trainable ilPFC-analog gate: computes per-candidate action bias favouring directed movement over the no-op class, emits a freeze-suppression scalar that overrides MECH-279 when threat and learned efficacy warrant, and updates the avoidance-efficacy EMA trace from realised outcomes.

nodes.name: InstrumentalAvoidanceGate.__init__
nodes.summary: Initialises the gate from a config, clamping initial efficacy to [0, 1] and seeding EMA/threat traces and diagnostic counters used by later ticks and updates.

nodes.name: InstrumentalAvoidanceGate.compute_action_bias
nodes.summary: Emits a per-candidate score-bias vector that penalises the no-op/freeze class in proportion to effective efficacy and threat, releasing directed instrumental actions without picking the escape direction itself.

nodes.name: InstrumentalAvoidanceGate.update
nodes.summary: Runs the eligibility-trace acquisition step: on a directed action under threat that drops z_harm_a it credits avoidance_efficacy toward 1; on freezing or failed avoidance it decays it, no-op under simulation_mode.

nodes.name: InstrumentalAvoidanceGate.last_output
nodes.summary: Builds an InstrumentalAvoidanceGateOutput snapshot summarising current avoidance efficacy, effective efficacy, threat scale, freeze-suppression scalar and last bias magnitude for diagnostics and manifest recording.

nodes.name: InstrumentalAvoidanceGate.get_state
nodes.summary: Returns a flat dict of scalar gate diagnostics (efficacy, effective efficacy, credit/decay/threat/freeze-suppression counters) suitable for downstream manifest emission and inclusion in scaffold curriculum results.

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: God-config module for the V3 REE agent: defines REEConfig plus every sub-config dataclass (latent stack, E1/E2/E3 systems, hippocampus, residue, heartbeat, goals, coalition, PFC/OFC/DACC, environment) and the from_dims factory that constructs a fully wired REEConfig for a given observation/action space. Imported by essentially every downstream ree_core module and treated as the top-level knob surface for experiments.
nodes.languageNotes: Python @dataclass-heavy module (~8.4k non-empty lines, 16 dataclasses); REEConfig itself spans ~6.1k lines and centralises defaults for the entire agent. `from_dims` is the canonical factory and threads dozens of derived defaults; `derive_stdlib_rng_seed` bridges torch RNG state to stdlib random.

nodes.name: derive_stdlib_rng_seed
nodes.summary: Derives a deterministic 63-bit integer seed for stdlib random from an integer base seed and a string label, so config-time seeding is stable across processes without importing torch.

nodes.name: LatentStackConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding all knobs for the latent-stack encoder/decoder pathway (dimensionalities, gating rates, dropout schedules, projection depths). Consumed by REEConfig and by latent-stack modules across ree_core.

nodes.name: E1Config
nodes.summary: Configuration dataclass for the E1 (early-perception / world-model) system, exposing its temporal-resolution, prediction-loss, and calibration knobs.

nodes.name: E2Config
nodes.summary: Configuration dataclass for the E2 (deliberative / model-based) system: rollout horizons, value-network parameters, and phase-3 arbitration flags.

nodes.name: E3Config
nodes.summary: Large configuration dataclass for the E3 (control/selection) system: action-selection temperature, competence-floor thresholds, diagnostics, hold-weighted readouts, and the many probe gates the substrate exposes.

nodes.name: EventSegmenterScaleConfig
nodes.summary: Per-scale configuration for the multi-scale event segmenter (surprise thresholds, min segment length).

nodes.name: EventSegmenterConfig
nodes.summary: Top-level event-segmenter configuration bundling per-scale settings and cross-scale integration knobs.

nodes.name: InvalidationTriggerConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for goal-invalidation triggers (thresholds and cooldowns that mark an anchor set stale).

nodes.name: AnchorSetConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the anchor-set primitive that scaffolds goal representation, including capacity, decay, and selection knobs.

nodes.name: StalenessAccumulatorConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the staleness accumulator that tracks how long an anchor or goal has gone unrewarded before invalidation is considered.

nodes.name: GhostGoalBankConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the ghost-goal bank (bank size, admission/eviction thresholds, decay schedules) that stores latent candidate goals for reactivation.

nodes.name: PersistenceAppraisalComputeConfig
nodes.summary: Small dataclass holding compute-time knobs (batch size, precision) for the persistence-appraisal path.

nodes.name: HippocampalConfig
nodes.summary: Large configuration dataclass for the hippocampal episodic-memory subsystem: pattern-separation and completion parameters, replay schedule, and consolidation gates.

nodes.name: ResidueConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the residue subsystem (care-marker / mood-regulation trace) driving INV-001 falsifiers and downstream residue-conditioned behaviour.

nodes.name: HeartbeatConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the heartbeat scheduler that drives phasic subsystems (sleep, consolidation ticks, residue decays).

nodes.name: EnvironmentConfig
nodes.summary: Small dataclass holding environment-side knobs (obs/action space overrides, wrapper toggles) that REEConfig consults during construction.

nodes.name: REEConfig
nodes.summary: Top-level agent configuration dataclass aggregating every sub-config (latent stack, E1/E2/E3, hippocampus, residue, heartbeat, goal/anchor, coalition, PFC/OFC/DACC, defensive orienting, environment) and providing the from_dims factory plus preset builders (large, xlarge, enable_goal_stream, enable_sleep_aggregation_cluster). This is the single object the runner and every experiment driver constructs to instantiate an agent.
nodes.languageNotes: Extremely large dataclass (~6.1k lines) with __post_init__ validation, a from_dims classmethod factory that threads dozens of derived defaults, and preset methods (large/xlarge/enable_goal_stream/enable_sleep_aggregation_cluster) that mutate self in-place. New knobs must be added at three sites: field definition, from_dims wiring, and any preset that touches the surrounding subsystem — bare from_dims silently swallows unknown kwargs, so tests must cover the new knob explicitly.

nodes.name: REEConfig.from_dims
nodes.summary: Primary construction path for REEConfig: takes observation/action dimensions plus overrides and returns a fully wired config, deriving defaults for every subsystem (E1/E2/E3, latent stack, hippocampus, goal stream, sleep aggregation, residue) and seeding stdlib RNG via derive_stdlib_rng_seed. Every experiment driver builds its agent through this classmethod.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses setattr/hasattr for optional-knob wiring; silently ignores kwargs not present on the dataclass, so new knobs need explicit test coverage.
